images.title: Six equilateral triangles make a hexagon
images.purpose: Show six equilateral triangles meeting at a point and forming a regular hexagon.
images.composition: One regular hexagon centred in the frame, divided into six triangles from its centre.
exact_structure: A regular hexagon with corners labelled A, B, C, D, E and F in order round the shape, and its centre labelled O.
Six straight segments from O to each corner, making exactly 6 congruent equilateral triangles.
The triangles are filled alternately teal (#0072B2) and amber (#E69F00), 3 of each.
At O, one of the six angles carries a small reddish purple (#CC79A7) angle arc labelled 60°.
At corner B, the two triangle angles that meet there carry one green (#009E73) angle arc labelled 120°.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Six 60° angles fill 360°, and each hexagon corner is 60° + 60° = 120°.
